title: Quick QR and viewer recovery pass automated checks
summary: 17 focused tests, TypeScript and lint pass for QR consent/cancellation, scanning from either role, self-scan rejection, flashlight/retry, viewer token recovery and connection persistence.

changes.detail: Either idle phone can open Scan a phone directly and become the viewer. Owner taps Allow QR connection on the sharing phone to grant one scanner screen/control access without a second approval tap. Separate random QR capability expires after two minutes and is revoked when hidden, replaced, used or stopped.
Return non-authentication status codes for rapid taps, paused streaming and a locked screen, so the viewer does not revoke a valid session. Reject scanning the same phone.
Flashlight and camera retry; viewer reload retry with same-origin in-memory token restoration after WebView process loss, without persistent token storage.
Repair QR translations, update recovery guidance, and prepare version 1.0.14/build 16. Preserve manual owner approval and Android capture permission.
Corrected scanner JSX, updated the remembered-address test after scanning, and moved QR expiry cleanup into native status polling after initial syntax/lint checks.

validation.name: Focused UI/viewer/history tests
validation.detail: 17 tests passed. Includes explicit QR display/cancellation, scanner on share/view screens, self-scan rejection, camera flashlight/retry, duplicate/background scans, same-origin token restoration, transient 409/429 responses, long pause/reconnect and history retention.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: TypeScript and ESLint passed after correcting initial syntax and state-effect lint findings.

validation.name: Native and physical acceptance
validation.detail: Native JVM tests and APK build pending. No real two-phone scanning or device lifecycle tests yet. No deployment.
